profile.summary: The Zellerbach Family Foundation is a Bay Area foundation that invests in work to strengthen families and communities. It has operated for over 65 years. Its grantmaking is organized around Safety & Belonging and Arts & Culture, and it serves San Francisco, Contra Costa and Alameda counties.

review.notes: The OUSD item is a grant application to the Zellerbach Family Foundation for an Oakland International High School project, and zff.org (San Francisco, serving Alameda County) plus its own page on the school's Family Resource Center match that funder. Name, address, phone, focus areas, counties and 65-year history are confirmed on zff.org, and the summary is neutral.
